title: Bar Salts Passionfruit Peach Lemon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape Bar Salts Passionfruit Peach Lemon combines the exotic sweetness of Passionfruit, the mellow juiciness of Peach, and the zesty tang of Lemon to create a bright and refreshing vaping experience. This carefully balanced tropical infusion offers layers of sweet and sharp notes, perfect for fans of bold and fruity flavour combinations. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Vampire Vape Bar Salts provide the perfect balance of rich flavour and smooth vapour, making them ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like starter vape kits , refillable vapes and pod kits . The nic salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, delivering the concentrated, bold flavours vapers expect from disposable vape bars. As part of a more sustainable alternative to disposable vape bars, Bar Salts e-liquids come in a 10ml format, offering a longer-lasting and more economical vaping option. Available in 0mg, 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Passionfruit Peach Lemon is a versatile and satisfying choice for adult smokers and vapers.
